name: Panel lift-out
oneLiner: a screenshot floats in a window; the page dims and one real panel lifts out of it toward the lens, leaving a dark socket behind, grows to a readable size with a glowing edge and a deep shadow, and a label chip hangs from it on a short stem and types itself
say: when the speaker singles out one part of an app or page and names its role ('this box is where you give it your input'): the page dims on 'this', the panel arrives big as they name it, the chip types the role. Set rect to the real panel in % of the screenshot (x,y,w,h)
